items.english: Troubled that Taki had apparently been listening to such high-spirited voices for some time, she urged him to set out. She feared that if she went away he would be sure to join their drinking. That Taki, given any chance, would take up with people of quite another sort and put on a foolish revel, the very thought of it was more than she could bear.
notes: 畑違ひ kept as 'of quite another sort' to keep class difference without fixing a trade; the last clause leaves her disgust general, as the Japanese does.

items.english: They waited for the bus that came by the hour, but it would not readily come, so talking again of the trip and other things they walked along the avenue of pines in the moonlight.
“The feeling of midsummer is only a very brief moment between July and August, I think.”

“When you put it that way, once we are into August the nights feel more like autumn. But thinking in that way, in winter or in spring too there are only a few days that are truly the peak. The whole year is just the seasons shifting past one another.”
“After this it must be the night in any case. With that light in that room it will never do, will it?”
notes: I take this to mean night work in his unlit study as days shorten, but the Japanese leaves the implication unstated, so I keep it flat.

items.english: “Is it not all right as it is?”
“No, however autumnal it gets, this time I mean to give up the night altogether.”
notes: 夜は絶対に止める: whether he means night work or staying up is not settled; I keep 'the night' literal rather than choosing.

items.english: When talk came to a stop she took a harmonica from inside her sash and walked along playing it. She had no other accomplishment to speak of, but strangely she was skillful at this. And from time to time she picked up the popular tunes from her middle school brother and others and practiced them eagerly. Lately she had mastered rather difficult pieces (?), such things as “Ai Ai Ai” and “Valencia” and “Light Cavalry.”
notes: 帯の間 rendered as 'inside her sash' per style sheet; song titles kept as transliteration; (?) kept to carry the narrator's ironic query on 難曲.

data.say: Drafted the moonlit walk to town through the harmonica passage, keeping night work ambiguous.
